relayedSummary: Integration Rule; Label Design; C/F high correlation; classification objective / EXIT utility misalignment; independent Winner Continuation / Profit Retention / Loss Containment; State/Signal/Pattern decision semantics; 6–8 finite candidates.

findings.reason: Independent authorities replace the C-weak AND F-strong bottleneck; high Continuation cannot categorically veto independently confirmed deterioration/protection.
Gen2 AUC does not establish EXIT utility. Freeze action-relative executable-reference utility targets, not high/low touch targets.
Observed score correlation and label overlap warrant diagnosis; they do not alone prove a model defect or a single causal source.
Winner continuation, profit protection, deterioration have separate semantic questions and explicit conflict priority.
Use causal transition/persistence/recovery with independent corroboration; UNKNOWN is not FALSE.
Neither DROP alone nor negative PnL alone is an EXIT rule.
Future targets remain training-only; observed completed owned prefixes and certified extrema have separate schemas.
User permits 4–8. Final finite structural hypotheses are selected only after Final Analysis; no reserve or threshold sweep.
Preserve exact existing numeric gate semantics, both Entry arms, missing/censoring rules and no-selection behavior.
Use only existing Ark frozen Entry costs and next-OPEN/auction sell-cost contract.
Entry Dual Freeze is permanent and is not reopened by EXIT failures.
No Gen3 learning this Work; later SELECT and Final EXIT Freeze are separate prerequisites.
Conditional GO is a design-review disposition, not performance validation, a selected strategy, or authorization to launch learning now.
